brief: Write three product descriptions for our hiking backpacks: the Ridge 30, the Summit 45 and the Trail 20. 50 to 70 words each. Each must give the pack's volume in litres.

delivery:
Hi Sam,

Here are the three backpack descriptions we agreed. I kept each one close to sixty words and put the volume near the start, since that's what people search for. Happy to adjust anything.

Ridge 30
Ridge 30 is the daypack built for long trails and changing weather. It holds 30 litres, enough for layers, lunch, a first-aid kit and a hydration bladder. The ventilated back panel keeps you cool on steep climbs, while padded hip belts spread the load evenly. Water-resistant ripstop fabric, side compression straps and a quick-access lid pocket make every mile easier.

Summit 45
Summit 45 is built for hikers who want room without bulk. Its main compartment holds 45 litres, enough for a weekend of gear, food, and layers. A ventilated back panel keeps you cool on steep climbs, while a padded hip belt spreads the load evenly. Side pockets fit water bottles, and the water-resistant fabric shrugs off sudden showers on the trail.

Trail 20
Trail 20 is the daypack built for long miles and quick summits. It holds 20 litres, enough for layers, lunch, water and a first aid kit, without feeling bulky on your back. Padded shoulder straps, a breathable mesh back panel and a hip belt spread the load evenly. Side pockets keep bottles handy, while the water-resistant fabric shrugs off sudden showers.

Thanks again for the work. The invoice goes through Held, so there's nothing to send.

Best,
Maya

brief: Write five FAQ answers for our bike rental shop: opening hours, deposit, helmets, late returns and child seats. 20 to 40 words per answer.

delivery:
| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| When are you open? | We're open every day from 9 am to 6 pm, including weekends and holidays. Bikes must be returned by closing time, so plan your ride accordingly and give yourself extra time. |
| How much is the deposit? | Yes, we ask for a 50 euro deposit when you pick up your bike. It's returned in full when you bring the bike back undamaged, refunded the same way you paid. |
| Do I get a helmet? | Yes, every rental includes a free helmet in your size. Just ask at the counter when you pick up your bike, and we'll fit it properly before you ride. Safety first, always. |
| What if I'm late? | If you return your bike after the agreed time, we charge a late fee of 10 euros per hour. Running behind? Call us and we'll extend your rental at the standard rate instead. |
| Do you have child seats? | Yes, we offer child seats for our bikes, suitable for kids up to 22 kg. Supplies are limited, so please book at least one day ahead by phone or online to guarantee availability. |
